newsitem.title: INDIA: India Mata MATASEC recommends Unit'64 for banks.
newsitem.headline: India Mata MATASEC recommends Unit'64 for banks.

text.p: Money market dealer Mata Securities said on Monday it recommended Unit'64 for banks and financial institutions and Mastershare and Masterplus'91 of Units Trust of India (UTI) for individual investors.

UTI has not raised the prices of Unit'64 too high to make it unaffordable and on the other hand, increased the repurchase price enough providing for easy exit for investor without loss, Mata Securities said in a report.
"This should encourage institutional investors to increase their investment in Unit'64 during August," it said.
Mastershare and Masterplus '91 are quoting high discount to their respective net asset value in this rising market providing a good investment opportunity for individual investors, it said.
